additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417603-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002648] Faulty socket CRM:02684000051
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Please plan a field service for case number
0417603
as per the following details:
Main Asset: MP / R9 170002648
Serial Number/Charger ID: ZIdhBZ
Problem Description: Outlet 3 Unavailable
Solution/Actions to be performed: Upon checking the logs, we found there is a communication issue between PLC and AC meter. Please plan a site visit to check the Modbus connections between PLC and AC meter (BC5) via Ethernet switch (XF2 & XF1).
Recommended Spare part MLFB: AC Meter 3P 65A Direct Modbus TCP MID > 7KM2200-2EA40-1JA1
Feel free to contact us, if you need further clarification/assistance.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman
